item.text:
The script failed because `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN` is blank. No sourcemaps were uploaded.

In Paseo, open **Settings → Plugins → project-env actions menu → Project environment**, edit this repository, and press **Test** to see why the variable failed.

The script is also a stub marked “fake: no network,” so it won’t perform a real upload even with authentication.
